33001.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station in Lakeport has caught 31.47 inches, 3.35 inches less than a usual year. May was the wettest month at 6.13 inches, and the biggest one-day reading was 2.17 inches on Aug 3. The gauge went 12 days in a row with nothing from Jul 3 to Jul 14. On the days both years reported, that is 3.49 inches more than 2025.

33005.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station in Jaffrey Silver Ranch Airpark had July as its wettest month at 5.94 inches. Most of that came on Jul 30, when the gauge caught 3.23 inches, the biggest single day of the year. That same month also held the longest dry stretch, 10 days in a row with nothing at all from Jul 9 to Jul 18. The station sits 1.27 inches behind last year at this point.

33019.story: Through Oct 12, the weather station in Newport has caught 30.00 inches, 2.18 inches less than a usual year. May was the wettest month at 5.51 inches, and the biggest single day came on May 15 with 1.27 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 9 days, Jan 29 to Feb 6, with not even a trace in the gauge.
